ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions on lateral lobes; thick black (low intensity) border along the trailing edge; a broad central black column extending from the peduncle to the median notch; localized black speckling/mottling in the medial zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression; central apex shows high pixel depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing boundary; high-frequency peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 10 pixels; most prominent on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a convex mathematical curve; leading edges are near-linear, tapering to sharp, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical-to-diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe interior; several fainter horizontal streaks on the inner-left lobe near the peduncle junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical pigmentation pattern creating an 'island' effect of white within a dark frame along the notch and leading edge boundaries.
